item.title: Mac Resource Monitor 1.4.2
item.description:
• Fixed: Gatekeeper no longer reports the app as unverified on a fresh download (the bundle was missing its package-type declaration).
  • New: Intel Mac support — the app now ships as a universal binary, so it runs on Intel Macs on macOS 14 or later. Power draw and per-chip stats that depend on Apple Silicon hardware are simply hidden there.

Since 1.4.0:

  • New: Explore logs — a read-only browser for what LM Studio and oMLX retain on disk. Server logs are grouped by month and filterable to the last 7 or 30 days; large logs open at the end and page backwards as you scroll, so even a multi-gigabyte file stays responsive.
  • New: Explore chats — LM Studio's saved conversations rendered as readable transcripts instead of raw JSON, with reasoning folded away, timings tucked out of the way, and images shown inline and click-to-enlarge.
  • Both browsers are strictly read-only: they can open and search what is stored, and can never modify or delete it.
  • The Local AI Storage panel's actions now live in a single menu on the card, with Purge set apart from the read-only browsers.
